An
des Königl. Großkanzlers Et.
Min. v Goldbeck Excellenz.
[Signature M?]
d. 6. ten Juny beides c. alltis ins.
Ewr Excellenz danke ich ver¬
bindlichst für die mir mit¬
telst geehrtesten Zuschrift
vom 11. m. c. von der
Rückkehr des v. Prusiemski und
des Xaver von Jezierski gegeben
Nachricht. Mit der mir geneig¬
test communicirten
original Cabinets Ordre remittire ich De¬
nen
nenselben hierbei die
von mir mitgezeichneten
Concepte und Mundo und
füge noch ergebenst hinzu,
daß ich unter Mitzeich¬
nung des Königl. Et. Min.
p v Voss Excellenz auch bereits
der Kammer zu Posen
aufgegeben habe diesen
bei den Subjecten nunmehro
den Huldigungseid ableisten
zu laßen.
Berlin den 30. May 1803
Haug[witz]

translation.en:
To His Royal Grand Chancellor, Minister of State, v. Goldbeck, Excellency.

[Signature M?]

d. 6th June both c. alltis ins.

I thank Your Excellency most kindly for the news given me in your most esteemed letter of the 11th of this month of the return of v. Prusimski and Xaver von Jezierski. With the original cabinet order kindly communicated to me I return to you

herewith the drafts and fair copies countersigned by me, and add most obediently that, with the countersignature of His Royal Minister of State etc. v. Voss, Excellency, I have also already instructed the Chamber at Poznań to have these subjects now take the oath of allegiance.

Berlin, 30 May 1803

Haug[witz]

text_english:
To His Royal Grand Chancellor, Minister of State, v. Goldbeck, Excellency.

[Signature M?]

d. 6th June both c. alltis ins.

I thank Your Excellency most kindly for the news given me in your most esteemed letter of the 11th of this month of the return of v. Prusimski and Xaver von Jezierski. With the original cabinet order kindly communicated to me I return to you

herewith the drafts and fair copies countersigned by me, and add most obediently that, with the countersignature of His Royal Minister of State etc. v. Voss, Excellency, I have also already instructed the Chamber at Poznań to have these subjects now take the oath of allegiance.

Berlin, 30 May 1803

Haug[witz]
summary_en: Haugwitz's draft of his reply to Goldbeck, Berlin, 30 May 1803. He thanks Goldbeck for his letter of 11 May with the news of the return of Prusimski and Xaver von Jezierski, returns the original cabinet order with the drafts and fair copies he has countersigned, and adds that, with von Voss's countersignature, he has already instructed the Chamber at Poznań to have the two now take the oath of allegiance. Signed Haug[witz]. A note at the head reads "d. 6. ten Juny" (the rest not read).
summary_de: Haugwitz' Konzept seiner Antwort an Goldbeck, Berlin, 30. Mai 1803. Er dankt Goldbeck für sein Schreiben vom 11. Mai mit der Nachricht von der Rückkehr Prusimskis und Xaver von Jezierskis, gibt die originale Kabinettsordre mit den von ihm mitgezeichneten Konzepten und Reinschriften zurück und fügt hinzu, dass er mit Voss' Mitzeichnung der Kammer zu Posen bereits aufgegeben hat, die beiden nunmehr den Huldigungseid ablegen zu lassen. Unterzeichnet Haug[witz]. Ein Vermerk am Kopf lautet "d. 6. ten Juny" (der Rest nicht gelesen).
